headline: Record bookings and strong growth; guidance raised
summary_short: Revenue rose 11% to $2.571B and AFFO per share grew 18% to $11.64, with record annualized gross bookings of $533M. Equinix raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $10.325B-$10.365B.
summary_long: Interconnection revenue grew 10% and Fabric revenue 24%. Monthly recurring revenue grew double digits for the fourth straight quarter. Net income got a boost from a non-recurring atNorth joint venture fee. Nearly 40% more cabinets are planned for delivery in 2026 than first expected. Fourth-quarter revenue is guided to $2.684B-$2.724B and full-year AFFO per share to $43.71-$44.11.
confidence_notes: AFFO and adjusted EBITDA are non-GAAP; AFFO growth of 12% per share excludes the atNorth fee on a normalized, constant-currency basis.

drivers.explanation: Strong underlying performance, with robust demand and strengthening pricing across traditional and AI workloads.
Higher operating income and a non-recurring fee earned in connection with the atNorth joint venture investment.
CEO says double-digit growth across key metrics, including interconnection and monthly recurring revenue, and accelerated capacity to meet broad-based demand.
